title: Build your engineering career with RNL
lead: We hire graduate and experienced civil and structural engineers, draftspeople and site staff to work on projects across Papua New Guinea.
body:
## Why work with us

- Work on real infrastructure: wharves, towers, bridges, schools and buildings across PNG
- Learn from registered professional engineers on design and on site
- Offices in Port Moresby, Lae, Kokopo and Goroka

## Graduate engineers

Each year we take on graduate civil and structural engineers. Graduates work alongside senior engineers on design, drafting and site supervision, building the experience needed for professional registration.
how_to_apply: Email your cover letter, CV and academic transcripts, with the position title in the subject line. We also post vacancies on our Facebook page.
